title: Requests for Relief from Paid Late Report Penalties — Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts
content:
## Rule

On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, a penalty relief request asks for part or all of a paid late report penalty to be refunded, and it concerns the quarter of the most recent payment applied to a penalty on the account. The request is lodged by the employer and is decided by the Department's tax review unit, which refunds the relief it grants.

The relief share is not fixed until the ledger carries a late report penalty for the quarter of the original report with the latest filing date, whenever that report was filed after its due date.

Put the other way: so long as the original report with the latest filing date was filed after its due date and the ledger carries no late report penalty for that report's quarter, the relief share is not yet fixed.

A late report penalty is relieved in part or in full only under this rule, and relief is requested no later than the abatement window after the penalty assessment date.

## Lodging the request: `request_penalty_relief_44d7156f`

**Capability.** One call lodges the employer's own request for relief from a late report penalty it has already paid, asking for an amount to be refunded. It records one penalty abatement request in the employer's name on the account for the quarter given, dated the day of the call, asking for the amount given to be refunded and citing the penalty entry concerned. The request is received for decision by the Department's tax review unit: nothing is credited or refunded by this call. The employer can see the request and its status in its online account.

**How it is invoked.** `request_penalty_relief_44d7156f` is the employer's own tool. The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the employer — the customer themselves — runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `employer_account_id` | The reference number of the employer's unemployment insurance tax account, as returned by the employer account lookup | Identifier |
| `penalty_entry_id` | The reference number of the balance-history entry of the late report penalty the relief is asked for, as shown in the account's balance history | Identifier |
| `quarter` | The calendar quarter of that penalty | Written YYYY-Qn, for example 2026-Q3. An empty value is never used for a relief request |
| `requested_amount` | The amount of the paid penalty asked to be refunded | US dollars with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no amount; passed already rounded to the cent and recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that starts with "Penalty relief request received" and states the request reference (an opaque reference beginning with "acr_"), the quarter, the cited penalty entry, the amount asked for in USD with 2 decimal places and the request status "received". That sentence means the request is on the account awaiting decision.

## Basis Q&A

**Who decides the request?** The Department's tax review unit, which refunds the relief it grants.

**Which quarter does a request concern?** The quarter of the most recent payment applied to a penalty on the account.
